n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Tom, dear, I need the health centre today. Just a check-up. Which stop is it?

translations.fa: تام عزیز، امروز باید برم درمانگاه. فقط یه چکاپ. کدوم ایستگاه؟

branches.suggestion: Tom's busy driving. Can I help?
branches.suggestionFa: تام سرش به رانندگی گرمه. می‌تونم کمک کنم؟

branches.suggestion: Is it the one on Essex Road?

n2.speaker: tom
n2.text: Essex Road, Doris. Get off at the next-but-one stop. {you} will show you.

translations.fa: اسکس رود، دوریس. ایستگاه بعد از بعدی پیاده شو. {you} نشونت میده.

branches.suggestion: First, we get off the bus.

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: It means the second stop. Thank you, dear. Then which way?

translations.fa: یعنی ایستگاه دوم. ممنون عزیزم. بعد از کدوم طرف؟

branches.suggestion: Then turn right at the lights.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: Right at the lights. After that?

translations.fa: سر چراغ راست. بعد از اون؟

branches.suggestion: After that, it's on your left.
After that, walk past the school.
branches.suggestionFa: بعد از اون، از جلوی مدرسه رد بشید.

match: after that is in your left
recasts.echo: After that, it's on your left? Lovely.
recasts.better: After that, it's on your left.

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: Past the school, then on my left. How many minutes?

translations.fa: از جلوی مدرسه، بعد سمت چپم. چند دقیقه؟

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Can you tell me again? Slowly? My memory is like a sieve!

translations.fa: می‌شه دوباره بگی؟ آروم؟ حافظه‌م مثل آبکشه!

branches.suggestion: First, straight on. Then right at the lights.
branches.suggestionFa: اول، مستقیم. بعد سر چراغ راست.

branches.suggestion: After that, it's on your left.

cultureNote.en: "A memory like a sieve" is a British idiom for forgetting things easily.

n7.speaker: tom
n7.text: Here's your stop, Doris! Mind the step. Good luck with the check-up!

translations.fa: ایستگاهت رسید دوریس! مواظب پله باش. چکاپت به خیر!

branches.suggestion: Do you want me to come with you?

n8.speaker: doris
n8.text: No, no, I'm fine. Straight on, right, left. Thank you, my dears! See you on Thursday, Tom!

translations.fa: نه، نه، خوبم. مستقیم، راست، چپ. ممنون عزیزانم! پنجشنبه می‌بینمت تام!
